statements.attributed: reported a HE 2D MoS2-based high entropy material with 8–16 atomic layers demonstrated for carbon dioxide electrocatalysis
statements.quote: To date, there has only been one report of a HE 2D MoS2‐based high entropy material—with 8–16 atomic layers, which has been demonstrated for carbon dioxide electrocatalysis. However, the preparation of this material requires highly toxic HF etching and annealing of the reaction vessel at 1000 °C, followed by a 120 h elemental annealing procedure on the component powders to generate the HE material.

statements.attributed: reported experimental procedures for investigating electrocatalytic performance toward HER
statements.quote: The electrocatalytic performance of the prepared materials toward HER was investigated via custom‐made experimental procedures integrated with the Nova software, similar to those reported previously. In brief, a series of five consecutive electrochemical impedance spectroscopy measurements (EIS) was performed with a step potential of 50 mV in the potential range of −0.4 to −0.6 V versus Ag/AgCl(3.5 m KCl) over the frequency range of 100–50 kHz with an imposed AC RMS amplitude of 7 mV peak‐to‐peak.
